title: 第5章 算计赵岚第6章 世外桃源
slug: 北侯世子反派的我背景逆天
lines: 深夜。
临安都督府内一片寂静，一道黑影骤然掠过，草木弯折，却没有一个侍卫有所察觉。
朱阳楼大殿中，一道黑袍身影忽然出现。
“武老？”
裴苏的眼神诧异，未曾想到武老不过半天便回来。
“少主，找到了。”
老者声音冷厉，唇角微翘，笑意诡谲。
“哦？是谁。”
裴苏将上好的蒙顶石花茶端在手中，轻轻搅动，茶香四溢。
“少主你让我调查的那人，名为赵岚，无父无母，只有一个铁匠养父，我踏入那铁匠铺的时候，没有人影，但我在后院中发现了······
“八荒刀箓的刀意刀气留下来的各种痕迹。”
裴苏抬眸，轻抿一口茶水。
那名为赵岚的侍卫年轻而修行有成，加之身负气运，让他生出些许怀疑，但也只是一个猜测，抱着试试态度，没想到还真······
揪住了尾巴。
他叹了一声：
“八荒刀箓，皇宫禁军统卫才有资格修行的顶尖刀法，没想到当年名震一时御林卫副统，竟藏在这小小并州做了个铁匠。”
“想来是那赵岚透露了少主存在，让萧粦心生警惕，先我一步而遁逃，但少主放心，我们此前已将【天宫石】交与临安郡关，他只要敢藏身份出郡······赫赫！”
黑袍老者如同见到猎物的兽，咧开嘴角。
天宫石，乃天下奇石之一，对天宫强者体内九重天宫极其敏感，稍一靠近就会光芒大作。
有天宫石的存在，萧粦只要胆敢靠近郡关，他必然暴露身份。
当然！以萧粦的实力，若想硬闯，当然没有问题，只是他一旦暴露，便逃不出老者的追杀。
想到此处，老者心中慨叹——
原本打算停留一月，一郡一郡的排查，没想到入并州不过半天，就在眼皮底下的临安郡发现了他的踪迹，真是走了大运······
不！
应该是幸好少主相助，先前便听闻少主修了一门神鬼莫测的望气之术，没想到竟恐怖如斯，一眼在人群里瞧出了端倪。
“萧粦短时间不会逃出的，他虽然并不知道我们携来了天宫石，但他肯定会猜到关卡处有陷阱等着他，所以接下来他会继续藏在郡内，等待时机。”
“那就派遣官兵在郡内地毯式扫荡，不过一郡之地，最多一周他便无处可藏！”
裴苏低头思索。
他萧粦不藏于庙宇深山，却偏偏藏在一州州府，是为何，这州府之地，难道比深山老林更加隐蔽？
在这临安郡内，只怕有个叫谁也找不着的地方，这萧仲庸方才有底气藏在郡城。
如果是这样的话......
“武老你是不是还忘了一个人？”
“少主是指，赵岚？”
“虽然不知萧副统领对他到底有几分真心实意，但还是试试吧，说不定，就钓出来了呢？”
裴苏笑意浅浅，脸上还是那副翩翩公子的模样。
世人皆闻北侯世子为人谦恭，温润如玉。
但只有裴家的少数高层才知悉，他们从小是怎么教导和培养裴家继承人的。
裴家需要的，可从来不是良善之人。
翌日清晨。
临安州府烟柳塘旁，一个小巧的古亭之中，柳芷携着几位世家小姐正在赏玩垂钓。
忽的看见一位身穿玄色蟒袍的年轻公子独自朝这边走来，在场小姐无不是对视一眼，面露惊喜之色。
“北侯世子！是北侯世子，他在往我们这边来吗？”

Late at night.
There was silence in Lin'an Governor's Mansion. A black shadow suddenly passed by, and the grass and trees bent, but no guard noticed it.
In the main hall of Zhuyang Tower, a figure in black robe suddenly appeared.
"Old Wu?"
Pei Su's eyes were surprised. He never thought that Mr. Wu would be back in just half a day.
"Young Master, we found it."
The old man's voice was cold and stern, the corners of his lips were slightly raised, and he had a strange smile.
"Oh? Who is it?"
Pei Su held the fine Mengdingshi scented tea in his hand and stirred it gently, the fragrance of the tea overflowed.
"Young Master, the person you asked me to investigate is named Zhao Lan. He has no father or mother. He only has an adoptive father who is a blacksmith. When I stepped into the blacksmith shop, there was no one there, but I found it in the backyard...
"The various traces left by the sword intent and energy of Bahuang Daolu. "
Pei Su raised his eyes and took a sip of tea.
The guard named Zhao Lan was young and accomplished in cultivation, and he was blessed with good luck, which made him have some doubts, but it was just a guess, and he had a try attitude, but he didn't expect it to be true...
Grabbed the tail.
He sighed:
"Bahuang Daolu, the top sword technique that only the Imperial Palace Imperial Guards are qualified to practice. I didn't expect that the deputy commander of the Royal Forest Guards, who was famous at that time, would hide in this small Bingzhou and become a blacksmith. "
"It seems that Zhao Lan revealed the existence of the young master, which made Xiao Lin wary and escaped one step ahead of me. But the young master can rest assured that we have handed over the [Tiangong Stone] to Lin'an County before. As long as he dares to hide his identity and leave the county... Hehe! "
The old man in black robe grinned like a beast upon seeing its prey.
The Tiangong Stone is one of the rare stones in the world. It is extremely sensitive to the Nine Tiangong Tiangong in the Tiangong strongman's body. It will shine brightly when it gets close to it.
With the existence of Tiangong Stone, as long as Xiao Lin dares to approach the county pass, his identity will be exposed.
Of course! With Xiao Lin's strength, if he wanted to force his way in, there would be no problem, but once he was exposed, he would not be able to escape the old man's pursuit.
Thinking of this, the old man sighed in his heart——
I originally planned to stay for a month and conduct investigations in one county, but I didn't expect that just half a day after entering the merged state, he would be found in Lin'an County right under my nose. I was really lucky...
No!
It must be fortunate that the young master helped me. I had heard that the young master had practiced an unpredictable energy-seeing technique before, but I didn't expect it to be so terrifying. I could see the clues in the crowd at a glance.
"Xiao Lin won't escape in a short time. Although he doesn't know that we have brought the Tiangong Stone, he will definitely guess that there is a trap waiting for him at the checkpoint, so he will continue to hide in the county and wait for the opportunity. "
"Then send officers and soldiers to sweep across the county, but within one county, he will have nowhere to hide in a week at most! "
Pei Su lowered his head and thought.
He, Xiao Lin, is not hiding in a temple or deep in the mountains, but he is hiding in a state capital. Why is this state capital more hidden than the deep mountains and old forests?
In Lin'an County, there is a place that no one can find, so Xiao Zhongyong has the confidence to hide in the county.
If that's the case...
"Mr. Wu, have you forgotten someone? "
"Young Master, you mean Zhao Lan? "
"Although I don't know how sincere Deputy Commander Xiao is towards him, I still give it a try. Maybe I can catch him? "
Pei Su smiled lightly, still looking like a handsome young man on his face.
Everyone in the world heard that Prince Beihou was as humble and gentle as jade.
But only a few senior members of the Pei family know how they taught and trained the heirs of the Pei family since childhood.
What the Pei family needs is never good people.
······
The next morning.
Next to the Yanliu Pond in Lin'an Prefecture, in a small ancient pavilion, Liu Zhi and several ladies from aristocratic families were enjoying fishing.
Suddenly, I saw a young man wearing a black python robe walking towards this direction alone. All the ladies present looked at each other with surprise on their faces.
"Prince Beihou! It's Prince Beihou. Is he coming to us? "
